articles.title: SpaceX and Tesla explore merger that would unite more than 30,000 bitcoin
articles.description: Independent committees are assessing a potential tie-up, while strong SpaceX earnings lift shares ahead of Tesla’s results.

articles.title: Monero futures are again heating with leverage, raising volatility risks
articles.description: Open interest has topped $300 million and price is back above $600. A similar setup was seen before January's crash.

articles.title: Tether leads $15 million funding round for AI-focused payment startup Mural
articles.description: The Series A round, which included participation from North Island Ventures and existing investors, brings New York-based Mural's total funding to $28 million.

articles.title: Zcash developers confirm November date for upgrade that triples payment speed
articles.description: The NU7 upgrade will cut the time between Zcash blocks to 25 seconds from 75 seconds. The chosen block height still has to be merged into the spec and shipped in node software.

articles.title: Ripple brings Wall Street into 24/7 stock bets, but HSBC warns markets are still thin
articles.description: Institutions can trade through Ripple Prime and post RLUSD as collateral. Finding enough buyers and sellers for large positions could prove harder.

articles.title: Solana’s Alpenglow, its biggest network overhaul since 2020, goes live Wednesday
articles.description: Alpenglow will replace the voting system Solana has used since 2020, targeting roughly 150-millisecond finality after months of testing that included a failed migration and rollback.

articles.title: A company that vouches for websites had secret keys so weak that 8 of them were cracked
articles.description: Eight secret keys at eMudhra, an Indian firm that vouches for websites, were compromised. This is a generic, not crypto-specific, risk.

articles.title: Bitcoin hovers around $83,000 as AI earnings revive tech, ZEC jumps 11%
articles.description: Strong results from SpaceX and Super Micro sent Asian chip stocks surging, and ZEC led crypto higher after developers set a date for its next network upgrade.

articles.title: U.S. CFTC sets agenda for AI forum, exploring trading and agentic finance
articles.description: A Commodity Futures Trading Commission task force is scheduled for October 28 to talk about how the latest "super intelligence" technology may impact markets.

articles.title: OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo calls corporate objections a ‘natural response’ to tokenized stock plans
articles.description: The former NY governor, who co-chairs the joint venture between the crypto exchange and Intercontinental Exchange, said companies were expected to take a wait-and-see approach.

articles.title: The Coinbase allegations expose Bitcoin's corporate governance gap
articles.description: Corporate adoption of bitcoin will stall as long as companies can't show who controls the money, who approves its movement, or whether it's still there, argues Onramp CEO Michael Tanguma.

articles.title: BlackRock seeks to shield bitcoin investors from losses after rival fund weathers 50% crash
articles.description: BlackRock's proposed fund follows similar products from Calamos that helped investors avoid steep losses during bitcoin's selloff.

articles.title: Kazakhstan court bars Coinbase, five others from unlicensed crypto services in Astana International Financial Centre
articles.description: The court injunctions apply strictly to users within the AIFC and do not extend across the rest of Kazakhstan.

articles.title: Microsoft, Alphabet and Goldman Sachs join objections to OKX-ICE tokenized stock trading
articles.description: Seven more issuers have opted out of being listed on the planned tokenized stock venue under the SEC's framework, bringing its disclosed objection count to 16.

articles.title: France's parliament approves vote to hit stablecoin trades with 31% capital gains tax
articles.description: Amendment I-3898 removes tax deferral for MiCA-compliant stablecoins starting January 2027.

articles.title: Equity weakness could damp demand for bitcoin after biggest ETF inflows in a month
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 20, 2026

articles.title: JPMorgan sees 10% annual bitcoin returns, topping stocks, bonds and gold over next decade
articles.description: The report marks the first time JPMorgan has put a range on bitcoin returns in its research, though the bank remains cautious about BTC's role in portfolios.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops to $81,400 as Asian chip stocks tumble, options traders seek downside protection
articles.description: Bitcoin slipped 0.5% to around $81,400 even after the biggest daily spot ETF inflow in nearly a month as South Korea's Kospi index fell 3.7% on AI worries.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin cuts losses as stocks edge higher
articles.description: Oil quickly plunged, but then reversed higher, on conflicting reports about the state of the war in Iran.

articles.title: South Korean IPO slump adds to AI market jitters as Brent crude tops $111
articles.description: Elice’s debut slump added to concerns over AI infrastructure valuations, while rising oil prices compounded market uncertainty.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs just saw their biggest day in a month thanks entirely to BlackRock
articles.description: Fidelity's FBTC and Grayscale's GBTC saw outflows of $83.6 million and $54.9 million, respectively.

articles.title: Tether: Senator's investigation misses positive work that's led to lower Iran volumes
articles.description: The stablecoin issuer's CEO, Paolo Ardoino, has been defending against accusations that the firm's stablecoins have fueled financial activity in Iran.

articles.title: U.S. CFTC rebuffs CME legal stance in consequential fight over perpetual futures
articles.description: The future of perps in the U.S. may be at stake as the CFTC argues that CME hasn't shown the new policy is hurting it after the agency OK'd its first bitcoin perp.

articles.title: Zerohash rolls out a new tool to move crypto without copying wallet addresses
articles.description: The launch comes as Zerohash bids for a federal trust charter.

articles.title: Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson is building a new programming language for the network
articles.description: Hoskinson said on X the language will bundle transaction requests with cryptographic proofs. He hasn’t shared a name, specs or a release date.
